newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends slightly higher in choppy trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends slightly higher in choppy trade.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices ended slightly higher on Wednesday, with some signs of a bottom in the market even though NYMEX gasoline futures failed to capitalize on an unexpected drop in U.S. inventories.
"There are some people who see an improvement to the recent environment but certainly not a change in the overall downtrend," a London broker said.
Eurograde barges ended up $3 at $203/$205 fob ARA. Last trades were heard at $204 for March delivery and at $204.75 for prompt material.
Regular unleaded rose $3 to $198/$200 and last traded at $199, brokers said.
Premium unleaded cargoes ended unchanged at $204/$206, and brokers said the bids and offers were rather wide apart today, possibly due to crude's volatility.
A tight Med market and seasonal factors were expected to cushion gasoline prices, even though the arbitrage to the States was barely open for large material and ARA barges were seen well supplied.
